title: Pride that boils over
odia:
କ୍ଷୀର ଉତୁରିଲେ ଚୁଲିକୁ,
ମଣିଷ ଉତୁରିଲେ ଗାତକୁ...!!!
literal_meaning: When milk boils over, it spills onto the hearth; when a person goes too far, into the pit.
explanation: The first line supplies an everyday overflow; the second turns it into a warning about arrogance. The source explicitly frames the saying as a response to excessive pride. Its sharp downward ending suggests that losing restraint can bring a fall.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଧ ଉତୁରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ସହ ଅତି ଗର୍ବର ପରିଣାମକୁ ମେଳାଯାଇଛି। ନିଜକୁ ବହୁତ ବଡ଼ ଭାବି ସଂଯମ ହରାଇଲେ ଅସୁବିଧା ହୋଇପାରେ—ଏହା ହିଁ ସତର୍କତା। ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଓ ଅହଂକାର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ଅଛି; ସଫଳତାରେ ଖୁସି ହେବାକୁ କଥାଟି ମନା କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: A successful team member begins dismissing everyone else’s advice, and a colleague warns against letting success become arrogance. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The comparison is between two kinds of overstepping. It is a figurative warning, not a prediction that every proud person will suffer a particular fate. The source’s digital punctuation is preserved.
